## Structure and components

- [statement] PCIe protocol tunneling encapsulates Transaction Layer Packets (TLPs) into transport frames, incurring packet assembly and disassembly overhead at host and device controllers. (high confidence) — https://www.thunderbolttechnology.net/tech · keywords: PCIe Protocol Tunneling and Thunderbolt Retimer Jitter · also: https://pcisig.com/specifications/pciexpress

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Retimer jitter and transport layer flow control credits cause non-deterministic round-trip DMA completion times, necessitating large contiguous transfers rather than layer-by-layer handshakes. (high confidence) — https://www.thunderbolttechnology.net/tech · keywords: PCIe Protocol Tunneling and Thunderbolt Retimer Jitter · also: https://pcisig.com/specifications/pciexpress
